title: omnibias: numerically-stable closed-form n-th derivative forward-pass framework
description: omnibias computes the closed-form n-th derivative of an activation, sigma^(n)(z), for arbitrary n with bit-stable accuracy and a single sigma evaluation regardless of order. The same primitive is exposed on PyTorch, JAX, and Keras 3 from one shared pure-Python coefficient core, so every backend is bit-identical by construction. The core math is the Riccati identity plus the Eulerian / Legendre / Hermite polynomial recurrences it implies, extended to multi-layer and multivariate Taylor jets via Bell / Faa di Bruno combinatorics. It also includes neural-jet symbolic regression / equation discovery that reads exact Taylor jets off a fitted field to recover ODE / PDE laws with full calculus primitives.
notes: omnibias ships 42 distributions in two licence tiers. The 28 permissive packages -- the derivative tower and everything built directly on it -- are Apache-2.0. The 14 certified-decision packages (verify, formal, sos, dynamics, convex, discrete, qubo, logic, nphard, submodular, combinatorics, routing, tab, control) are AGPL-3.0-or-later or available under a commercial licence from Derivon. No permissive package depends on a copyleft one. See LICENSING.md.
